title: University of Kansas announces spring 2026 honor roll
summary_en: More than 9,000 Jayhawks were named to the dean's lists for their respective schools for academic excellence in the spring 2026 semester.
title_cn: University of Kansas announces spring 2026 honor roll

title: Entrepreneurs need partners unless solo founder has broad and deep experience, study finds
summary_en: In a new scholarly article published in the Strategic Management Journal, a University of Kansas business scholar explored whether entrepreneurs need co-founders, finding disadvantages partially diminished when a solo founder has broad and/or deep experience.
title_cn: Entrepreneurs need partners unless solo founder has broad and deep experience, study finds
